title: My Neighborhood
text:
I live in a small neighborhood. There is a park near my house. Many children play there after school. There is also a small bakery on the corner.

My friend Ali lives next to me. He has a red bicycle. We ride our bikes in the park on Sunday. The bakery sells good bread.

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the neighborhood?
Why do the people in the passage probably go to the bakery?

vocabulary.definition: the area where people live near their homes
a shop that sells bread and cakes
a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal

paragraph_translations: Küçük bir mahallede yaşıyorum. Evimin yakınında bir park var. Okuldan sonra birçok çocuk orada oynar. Köşede küçük bir fırın da var.
Arkadaşım Ali yanımda oturuyor. Kırmızı bir bisikleti var. Pazar günü parkta bisikletlerimizle gezeriz. Fırın iyi ekmek satar.
